title: Create Annotation
content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍Create [Annotation](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219363481) on the Viewer to communicate with your team online, real-time. * Create Annotation **• Create Annotation** --- * Start by uploading a file. You may upload 3D files (zprj, zpac) or other image files (jpg, png, etc.) to create the annotation on. Or, you can use the Sample Content for practice.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778306163097) * Once uploading is complete, enter the Content page, and click '[**Annotation**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219363481)' at the top right corner of the viewer. Annotation is available both on the 3D Viewer and Image Viewer.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778306482969) * Start inserting comments, shapes, lines, or images to leave your feedback. Once you're done, click on 'Complete' at the top right corner. Full list of Annotations on the right pane, by clicking on the annotation icon.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778299318809) * When complete, start sharing the content page with your teammates. Learn how to [Share](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303215288985).
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to create and share annotations in real-time using the Viewer, enhancing team communication and collaboration.

title: Search Contents
content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍Learn how to search your files in CLO-SET, fast and easy. * Search Tab * In Workroom * In Company / Brand / Line / Season **• Search Tab** --- #### 🔎 Search Tab allows users to locate all the Content(s) they have access to within the Group * Access the Search tab from the dashboard. Click the 'Search' icon on the far left. * Type in keyword or upload images to start the search. Utilize filters to narrow the search results. | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 9.10.54 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778290959897) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778297815961) ---|---|--- * **Keyword search** : Search using the Content Name, Creator, or Content ID * **[Image search](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161): **Search using image files, to find similar Contents | ![CLO-SET_Default_Final_Butter.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778291422873) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.05.37 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778305402393) ---|---|---|--- * **Filter Results:** Narrow the search scope with the filters. If you have not yet, learn how to [input data & labels](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) to each Content * [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) * [Space](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176120217) * [Workflow](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) * [Category](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) **• In Workroom** --- #### 🔎 Searching in Workroom will display all matching results within the Workroom ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778276939033) * Enter the desired Workroom to start * From the 'Search For' drop-down menu, select the scope of search * Contents of Current Room: search the Contents within the current level Workroom only * Contents Including Child Rooms: search the contents from the current Workroom and all its child Workrooms. * Workrooms: search the Child Workrooms within the current Workroom * Type in the keyword. Search results display all matching results within the designated scope * Currently, CLO-SET does not support placeholders when searching **• In Company / Brand / Line / Season** --- #### 🔎 Search for Workrooms or Contents within a specific space * From 'Search For' drop-down, select the search level (Content / Brand / Workroom / Assortment) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778298566937) * Type in the keyword and hit enter. Search results display matching results within the space * When you search for a Workroom/Assortment within a specific Space (Company, Brand, or Line), ALL associated Workrooms/Assortments within that Space will be displayed ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778305861273)
content_description: Discover how to efficiently search for files and content in CLO-SET using various methods and filters for quick access.

title: China Account Sign Up
content:
## **Objective** Follow the instructions below to create a China account in CLO-SET 1. [Sign Up Guide (China User)](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261711540377) 2. [Troubleshooting](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261711540377) 3. [Using CLO & Marvelous Designer](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261711540377) ``` *For questions related to your account (creating, merging, deleting) or subscriptions, please visit the **[CLO Virtual Fashion Help Center](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc)**.
``` ## **Details** #### **1) Sign Up Guide (China user)** * If you are an existing CLO-SET user, please follow the account merging guide [HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261721190041). * If you do not have a CLO-SET account yet, please follow the steps below. 1\. Type in your email, password, and mobile number for SMS verification. 2\. Follow Captcha verification process 3\. Verify your email to activate your account 4\. Account creation complete. Please log in to start using CLO-SET ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778257749017) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778234869273) | ![Body \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778258403225) ---|---|--- #### **2) Troubleshooting** * Not receiving SMS verification? Please contact us via [support@clo-set.com](mailto:support@clo-set.com) or **[submit a request](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new)** * Not receiving verification email? Visit [HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261750460569) * Email address already in use ![Sign Box \(2\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778258605209) * * if your email address is already in use, please use a different email address to sign up. * OR,[ find the password](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9026105112591) for your existing account. #### #### #### **3) Using CLO & Marvelous Designer** **[Important]** Starting from the **2024.0 version** of **CLO Individual** and **Marvelous Designer Personal license** , you can start using your CLO-SET account to access CLO and Marvelous Designer * **Before** 2024.0 Release ([For Individual/Personal Users](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261697330329)) * To start using **[CLO](https://www.clo3d.com/)** and **[Marvelous Designer](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/)** , please create an account on the website. We recommend using the same email address as you did in CLO-SET, for a smoother account merging process * To access CLO and Marvelous Designer (before 2024.0 version), please use your User ID and Password for each service. * MD 2024.0 release scheduled in Late February * CLO 2024.0 release scheduled mid-March * **After** 2024.0 Release (For Individual/Personal Users) * Start using CLO-SET account to access CLO and Marvelous Designer software. * Your accounts in CLO, Marvelous Designer, and CLO-SET will automatically be merged based on the email address registered with your account. * Learn more on the Merged Account (CLO-SET account) [HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261751126937).
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for creating a CLO-SET account in China, along with troubleshooting tips and instructions for using CLO and Marvelous Designer software.

title: Leave Comment
content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍Leave [Comments](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171263641) and tag your teammates for a real-time communication. * Leave Comment * Workroom Comment * Mention Users **• Leave Comment** --- * Commenting is available on Content, Web Tech Pack, and Workroom. * In Content page, click on the 'Comment' icon (![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778051055129)) on the right pane to leave comment ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778080771993) * Type in your comment, or attach image files * [Invite/Share ](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303215288985)other teammates to mention them in the comment * Edit the text format or insert attachments as needed ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778081002777) **• Workroom Comment** --- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778094819865) * Commenting is also available at Workroom (![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778081364505)) level * In the Workroom, click the comment icon (![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778051055129)) on the right pane * [Invite/Share ](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303215288985)other teammates to mention them in the comment **• Mention Users** --- * Mention a single user or [Teams](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303212732441) to the comment for faster review * To mention a user, please [invite/share](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303215288985) other teammates first ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778102463129)
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for leaving comments and tagging teammates to enhance real-time communication within the platform.

title: Review Design
content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍 Review your 3D designs in CLO-SET ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776492571033) * 3D Viewer * 2D Pattern Viewer * Render Viewer * Share Feedback (Annotation / Comment) # **📓 Details** **•3D Viewer** --- 1\. From your Workroom or Dashboard, click the Content to enter 2\. Click the viewing tools, function bars, and create mode to review and explore the design | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776477833113) | ![Screen_Shot_2022-10-14_at_3.31.48_PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776509876889) ---|---|--- 3\. Rotate the garment, or zoom in & out to view the design in detail ** ** | **Mouse / Keyboard** | **** | **3D Viewer** ---|---|---|--- Roll up/down the Cursor | **![Scroll.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776541773593)**| Zoom in / Zoom out Hold down the cursor wheel and drag | ![Mouse \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776485888153) | Pan 3D View Hold down the right click and drag | ![right click and rotate.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776478515993) | Rotate 3D View Number keys | 🔢 | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776478701849) ***** For details on **Mac Navigation** , please find the[ attached PDF file](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776510655257) **•2D Pattern Viewer** --- 1\. On the Content page, click the '2D' thumbnail button to begin ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776479072921) 2\. On the Viewer, find the display toolbar to control the view | ![Screenshot 2024-11-12 at 11.52.21 AM 1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776510983833) | ![Screenshot 2024-11-12 at 11.52.34 AM 1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776479377817) | ![Screenshot 2024-11-12 at 11.52.43 AM 1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776494705177) ---|---|---|--- 3\. Pan or zoom in & out to view the 2D patterns in detail ** ** | **Mouse / Keyboard** | **** | **3D Viewer** ---|---|---|--- Roll up/down the Cursor | **![Scroll.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776541773593)**| Zoom in / Zoom out 1) Wheel Click + Move Mouse **OR** 2) Alt (Option) + Left Mouse Button + Move Mouse | ![Mouse \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776485888153) | Pan 2D Pattern View **•Render Viewer** --- * For Contents that have been [Rendered in CLO-SET](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303113033113), you can review the Render online. * On the content page, click the Render viewer from the viewer list to enter * Click the Colorways at the bottom to switch the view ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776527498649) **• Share Feedback (Annotation / Comment)** --- * Share your feedback by creating Annotations or leaving Comments. title: Configurator
content: #### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776461882649) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776436311961)Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776404239001) Editor #### Supported File Type: zpac, zprj, zfab ## **Objective** Try CLO-SET Configurator to explore design options online. Instantly review different color, texture, and property options with your team. ![Configurator10.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776436997785) 1. Configurator: How-to 2. Color Editor * [Color Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303194294425) 3. Texture Editor 4. Property Editor 5. Downloading the New Colorway 6. Create New Version 7. Best Practice Workflow ## **Details** ### 1) Configurator: How-to ![Click Configurator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776420464537) | ![Screenshot 2023-07-19 at 1.47.20 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776453124505) | ![Screenshot 2023-07-18 at 3.40.29 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776437534233) | ![Screenshot 2023-07-18 at 3.41.12 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776453463449) ---|---|---|--- 1. Click on the ![configurator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776405722009) (Configurator) button from Content page. 2. Select an item to edit from the Material List 3. Select a new option from Color/Texture/Property tab, and click '**Create** ' 4. New Colorway has been added under the 'Colorway' tab. Colorways created with CLO-SET Configurator will have the ![Icon Pack \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776463660057)icon. 5. Hover over the new Colorway on the right-pane to delete. ### 2) Color Editor * Pick a Color from palette to apply on your design * Reset the color by 'Reset color' button at the bottom * Click 'Create' to save the new colorway * Upload a [Color Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303194294425) to be shared with your team. **Picker** | **PANTONE** | **coloro** | **CUSTOM** ---|---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 4.51.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776421537817) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 4.51.27 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776454140569) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 4.51.38 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776464361881) | ![CUSTOM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776469977241) ### 3) Texture Editor ## ![Screenshot 2023-07-19 at 1.40.49 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776454757273) * Upload a Texture image * Adjust the texture using: * Gizmo on the style * Position/Scale/Rotation button on Configurator * Use Desaturation option * Reset Texture or Create new colorway ### 4) Property Editor ![Screenshot 2023-07-19 at 1.49.34 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776465069977) * Edit the Property of the file - Opacity, Roughness, Intensity, or Metalness * Click 'Reset Property' to reset it to match the original file * Click 'Create' to create a new colorway ### 5) Downloading the New Colorway Select 'All Colorways' option to download a new .ZPRJ file including both the 1) Colorway from your original content, and 2) new Colorways created with configurator (![Icon_Pack__1_.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776463660057)) ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776465404697) | ► | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776471201689) ---|---|--- * Choose the version you wish to download. **Hover over the version tab > click on ••• > select 'All Colorways'** * 'Original Content' option will only include colorways from your original zprj file * Upload the new zprj file to use: Render, Web Tech Pack, Line Sheet, Embed/Fitting ### 6) Create New Version * Creating a new Version will help make the New Colorway(created with Configurator) compatible with all CLO-SET features. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776423191449) 1. **Save** : Save the work before creating a new Colorway. Once saved, you can exit out of the Configurator tool and use other 3D viewer options (exploded view, schematic render, etc.) for review. 2. **Add Colorway** : Create a new Colorway to be added on your Colorway list on the right pane. Colorways made with Configurator will have the ![Icon_Pack__1_.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776463660057) icon. 3. **Create New Version** : Create a new [Version](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) including the new Colorways made with Configurator. Creating a new Version will help make the New Colorway compatible with all CLO-SET features. ![Picture1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776482977305) *Please note: for ZFAB files, you may only create a new version. Adding a new Colorway to the original file is unavailable. ### 7) Best Practice Workflow ![configtable.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776483159321) * **3D Garment** : Create new Colorways with Configurator, and create new Version to create production materials such as Render and Tech Pack. * **Block Pattern** : Start from a block pattern to create new Colorways for a new season. * **ZFAB** : create new patterns or color options for an existing ZFAB file in CLO-SET.
content_description: Explore the CLO-SET Configurator to effortlessly design and customize your garment options online, collaborating with your team to create unique colorways, textures, and properties.

title: Create Assortment
content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍CLO-SET [Assortment](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168765593) is the ultimate tool for showcasing your entire collection. 1. Upload Content(s) 2. Create Assortment 3. Review Assortment 4. Mix & Match # **📓 Details** **1\. Upload Content(s)** --- 1\. Enter [Dashboard](https://www.style.clo-set.com), and click the '+' button to start ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776367364505) 2\. Select a file from your local drive. You can upload ANY file format (including non-3D files). Then, click 'Upload'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776367477145) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776361898777) 3\. Select a **Workroom** to upload the file (Workroom is similar to folders in CLO-SET) * Click the ▶ button next to space names to expand * Select a Workroom, and click 'Next' | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776335862297) | ▶ | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776319421209) ---|---|---|--- 4\. Once complete, find your Content on [Dashboard](https://style.clo-set.com) or the designated [Workroom](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) **2\. Create Assortment** --- * To start, enter the Workroom you uploaded the Content(s) * All Contents must be uploaded in Workroom first, to be moved to Assortments * Select the Content(s) to move, and click Assortment from the floating menu. * Select an Assortment room to use, or create new Assortment ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776336183961) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776319694873) **3\. Review Assortment** --- * Enter the Assortment to start * Adjust the layout with the sizing menu, or hover over the Content to switch **Viewing modes** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776304740633) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776368768793) * Switch View By options to adjust the Assortment layout * View By **Content** : displays 1 [default Colorway thumbnail](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129) of each Content ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776336968985) * * View By **Colorway** : displays each Colorway as a separate image ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776305503769) * Active the **'Synchronized' camera** at the top menu bar, and hover over any Content to open the Turntable bar. Click the Turntable bar and move the mouse to rotate the designs together ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776305694745). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776337463577) * To **change the order** of Content(s), click 'Change Order' icon at the far right of the menu bar. Click & drag the Contents to adjust the order, and click 'Save As New Order' button. Type in the name of the order, and click 'Save' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776353913369) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776354102553) **4\. Mix & Match Contents** --- * [Mix & Match](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303205588377) the Contents to review the full outfit ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776369808025) * From the Assortment, select Content(s) and click 'Mix & Match' icon from the floating menu * Designate each Content as either Top or Bottom. Please make sure to check before clicking OK ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776338206105) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776364628377) * Drag & drop the Contents to viewer, and adjust the fit with the Gizmo tool
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for users to efficiently upload, create, review, and mix & match their clothing assortments using the CLO-SET platform.

title: Design File Management
content: # **📝 List of Contents** 📍 Learn how to setup CLO-SET Group to effectively manage project-based design files. For instructions on how to manage shared component files (block patterns, fabric, trims), visit [**HERE**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303154146201). * Setup Group Structure * Setup Workroom Structure * Upload Content(s) * Invite Team # **📓 Details** **• Setup Group Structure[(Instruction Guide)](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776315217433)** --- * Once you sign up, a new [**Group**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) will be created for you (ex. A's Group) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776315434905) * In CLO-SET, a 'folder' for uploading the files is called [**Workroom**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) * Please note: Uploading can ONLY be done on **Workroom** level * Take a moment to reflect how you'd like to setup the structure. We recommend reflecting on how your organization chart is setup. * Don't worry, you can always [copy](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303256878105) or [move](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303167509913) Contents and Spaces, or [copy the space structure](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171480345) as needed * EX) Group Structure in CLO-SET ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776347402009) * * EX) Organization Chart in CLO-SET View ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776331809433) * When you're ready, start customizing & expanding your Group structure. To view the space setup, click 'Browse'. To create a new space, click the '+' icon at the top. | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776358602137) | | | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776332621209) ---|---|---|--- **• Setup Workroom Structure** --- * Again, a 'folder' for uploading the files is called [**Workroom**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) in CLO-SET. * Start creating Workrooms per your needs. Click 'Browse' > Select a Season space > click the '+' button on the top to create a new Workroom. * To rename, double-click on the Workroom Name. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776348308249) **• Upload Content(s)** --- * Once you are done setting up the Structure, start uploading the asset(s) in Workroom or Company Library * Enter the Workroom/Company Library, and click '+New' at the top-left corner * OR, simply drag & drop your asset(s) to the Workroom/Company Library * **Bulk uploading** is supported using above options ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776301470105) **• Invite Team**(optional) --- * Once the Space setup is complete, invite your team members to start the collaboration * Refer to the **[Group Setup Instruction PDF](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776315217433)** for more details **[![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 2.27.55 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776317353369)](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776315217433)**[![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 2.28.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776317585049)](%20https://clo-set.zendesk.com/guide-media/01HKPR4QHVGJZB32G856JVVMJZ)
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide to setting up and managing your CLO-SET Group and Workroom structures for efficient collaboration on project-based design files.

title: New Configurator
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193164697)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776177016345)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776224902169)Editor # **Objective** Learn how to use the New Configurator in CLO-SET 1. Requirements 2. Configurator UI 3. Color * Color Switch 4. Basic Parameters * Auto-generate Normal Map 5. Reflection 6. Graphic Editor 7. Save/Add Colorway 8. Troubleshooting # # **Details** ### **Learn about the New Configurator from the CLO-SET Team!** ### 1) Requirements Compatibility: Zprj/Zpac files saved on CLO 2024.1.244 or above ### 2) Configurator UI ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776242623001) 1. **Configurator Tab** * On the [new Content Page](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303276351001), select the 'Configurator' tab to use the tools. 2. **Object Browser** * View the list of objects used on the garment. Select an object to edit. 3. **Colorway List** * List of Colorways (from original file & created via CLO-SET Configurator) 4. **Tool Bar** * Switch between 'Select' and 'Edit Texture' tool * ![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305) Select object to be edited * ![Icon Pack \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776177664665) Edit Texture to zoom in/out or move the applied texture with a Gizmo tool. *Using the 'Edit Texture' will edit all 6 maps in Basic Parameters and Reflection. To edit each parameters separately, please use the Basic Parameters tab to input specific values. 5. **Property Editor** * Edit material property including Color, Basic Parameters, and Reflection. 6. **Save/Add Colorway** * 'Save': edits made will be saved to the current selected Colorway. Only available for Configurator-created Colorways. * 'Add': edits made will be saved as a new Colorway ***Please Note** : New Colorways created with New Configurator are **NOT** editable on the conventional [Configurator](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303180764313). ### 3) Color 1\. To start, select an object from your garment (![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305)) 2\. Click on 'Color' tab to start editing. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776185951257) 3\. Choose the color to be applied to the selected pattern **Picker** | **PANTONE** | **coloro** ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2024-07-02 at 5.16.01 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776186110489) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-02 at 10.53.05 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776209735193) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-02 at 10.53.20 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776209927705) * **Picker** : select the color to apply from the color picker, and click 'Find' below to find similar PANTONE color chips. Users may select from HEX/RGB/HSL options to input the color code. * **PANTONE** : select a color chip to be applied. Use the drop-down list for PANTONE palettes. * **coloro** : select a color chip to be applied. Search using the color name * **Custom** : select a color chip from your [custom palette](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303194294425) 4\. Use the '< (Back)' button to edit other material properties, or click 'Reset' to reset the properties. *Please note the the 'Reset' option will reset all properties including Color, Texture, and Reflection. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776186733721) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776210290969) ### [Color Switch] Color Switch prepares the solid fabric for a smooth transition to the newly selected color, ensuring it is applied accurately and seamlessly. * * Learn about the Color Switch feature in **[CLO 2024.2](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Materials#01J8J0B16SJ6HJCMDVGKG9XNFB)**![Switch Color.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776244377753) * **How To:** Open the [New Configurator](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303181526297), and select an object to start * From the right pane, click 'Base Color Map' tab * Below the Base Color Map, you will find the 'Color Switch' option * Please note that you can ONLY use either Desaturation or Color Switch, not both. When one is turned off, the other can be activated * Once the 'Color Switch' is turned on explore new colorways by changing the Color or Opacity * Color Switch and Desaturation can be used for all types of objects, except for button hole.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776195896729) ### 4) Basic Parameters 1\. To start, select an object from your garment (![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305)) 2\. Click on 'Basic Parameters' tab to start editing. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776185951257) 3\. Choose the maps to be applied to the selected pattern **Texture** | **Normal Map** | **Displacement Map** | **Opacity Map** ---|---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776211068953) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-03 at 5.20.11 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776227613209) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-03 at 5.20.32 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776188104985) | ![Screenshot 2024-07-03 at 5.20.46 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776211571353) * Basic Parameters works the same as in CLO's Property Editor. Learn more **[HERE](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures)**. * Select the parameter to edit * Upload, delete, or download a new map to be applied * Type in specific number fields to adjust the parameters in detail * *Opacity can be applied without the Opacity Map, and will be applied to the whole fabric. To apply opacity to selective parts of the fabric, please upload an opacity map. 4\. Use the '< (Back)' button to edit other material properties, or click 'Reset' to reset the properties. *Please note the the 'Reset' option will reset all properties including Color, Texture, and Reflection. ### [Auto-generate Normal Map] CLO-SET will auto-generate a Normal Map based on the Base Color Map for objects that have only the Base Color Map applied and no Normal Map available. * **Conditions** : Normal Map will be generated ONLY when the selected object meets ALL of below * has Base Color Map * does NOT have normal map * user adjusts Normal Map Intensity to a non-zero value ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776196960025) | ▶ | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776197087001) ---|---|--- * Deleting the base color map of the object will also delete the normal map.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776197384985) * The auto-generated normal maps will be deactivated when the Intensity is set back to 0.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776198025497) ### 5) Reflection 1\. To start, select an object from your garment (![Icon Pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776193937305)) 2\. Click on 'Reflection' tab to start editing ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776185951257) 3\. Adjust the Reflection. Reflection works the same as in CLO's Property Editor. Learn more **[HERE](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures)**. * Reflection has 2 properties - Roughness and Metalness * Roughness can be edited in 2 modes - Intensity & Roughness Map ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776214709657) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776246790169) * * **Intensity** : Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness * **Roughness Map** : Edit fabric gloss by adding/modifying Roughness Map * Metalness can be applied without the Metalness Map, and will be applied to the whole fabric. To apply metalness to selective parts of the fabric, please upload a Metalness map. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776256678809) ### 6) Graphic Editor * **Select** : Click on the graphic directly, or select the graphic from the object browser. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262746441753) * **Edit** : Click and drag the Gizmo to adjust the Graphic: ![graphic editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262742100761) * * Triangle ▲ \- Uniform scale, adjust **width & length** in fixed ratio * Outer Circle ⦿ \- Rotate the angle of graphic * Inner Circle • \- Changes the position of graphic * **Change** : Select the graphic and click 'Basic Parameters' from the right pane. * Download: download the graphic file currently in use * Change: upload a new graphic to replace current graphic ![mceclip0 \(2\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262742102553) * **Graphic Requirements** * Graphic properties must meet below requirements to use CLO-SET Graphic Editor: * Tile = None * Over Seamline = Off ![mceclip1 \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262742103577). ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262746458649) * * If not met, Graphics will be marked ❌ from the object browser, and you can only adjust the Color of the graphic in CLO-SET. Please make changes on the .zprj/.zpac file from CLO3D software. ### 7) Save/Add Colorway ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776198953113) * When editing is complete, click _**'Add Colorway**_ ' to create a new Configurator-created Colorway. All new Colorways created in CLO-SET will have the purple water drop icon on the Thumbnail. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776247252377) * Users cannot overwrite the Colorways from original file. Edits made can only be saved as a new Colorway (with purple water drop icon). * Configurator-created Colorways (with purple water drop icon) can be edited/saved on CLO-SET. ***Please Note** : New Colorways created with New Configurator are **NOT** editable on the conventional [Configurator](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303180764313). ### 8) Troubleshooting * Compatibility: to use Configurator, please use a desktop or laptop. Any monitors with resolutions below 800 cannot use Configurator * Per the object type, there may be limitations to which parameters can be adjusted. Such restrictions will be disabled per the user's object selection. * For example, you can only edit the Color of Graphic. Basic Parameters and Reflection will be disabled.
content_description: This web page is designed to guide users through the features and functionalities of the New Configurator in CLO-SET, enabling them to effectively edit garment properties, manage colorways, and troubleshoot issues.

title: Create Space
content: # **Objective** CLO-SET provides a tailored Space structure tailored for Fashion industry. Start adding new Spaces to build a unique structure that meets your Company's needs. 1. CLO-SET Space Hierarchy 2. Creating each Space # **Details** ### 1) CLO-SET Space Hierarchy CLO-SET Group consists of Spaces from Company all the way to Workroom & Assortment. Workroom is where you can directly upload your Contents and Assets. You may also manage permission by Space. Learn more [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 1.47.26 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778728250393) ### 2) Creating each Space **** **Creating Company** Go to 'Companies' and click ![mceclip5.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778744034841) icon to create the Company. You can select the Company picture, color and name. Click 'Confirm' to create the Company. **Creating Brand** Go to 'Brands' and click ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778728655129) icon to create the Brand. You can select the Brand picture, color and name. Click 'Confirm' to create the Brand. **Creating Season** Once you enter into the specific Brand page, click ![mceclip3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778744524057) icon to create the Season. You can type the name of the Season and click 'Confirm' to create the Season. **Creating Workroom/Assortment** Once you enter into the specific Season page, click ![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778728958617) icon to create the Workroom or Assortment. You can type the name of the Workroom/Assortment and click 'Confirm' to create the Space. **Creating Sub-workroom** You can create multiple sub-workrooms under Workroom. Once you enter into the specific Workroom page, click ![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778728958617) icon and click 'Confirm' to create the sub-workroom.
content_description: CLO-SET empowers fashion companies to customize their operational structure by creating tailored Spaces, from Company to Workroom, to effectively manage content and permissions.

title: Linked Contents (Parent-Child Contents)
content: #### Permission: ALL (applicable to all Contents you have download/upload access to) # **Objective** With this update, you can now link the Contents when uploading new files from CLO. Create the Parent-Child relationship between old and new seasons OR between block files and final output to better track and manage your assets. ![linkfromclo.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778390531097) 1. [How To](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/8737455380879#h_01HKC8NSJMKEA2BNCCV3VY44BB) 2. [Requirements](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/8737455380879#h_01HKCA5BCE4VDBKJYE1WMK8F9T) # **Details** ### 1) How To To use this feature, you must first setup CLO-SET Library in CLO 3D. Find instructions [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191662617). * First, download a file from your CLO-SET Library in CLO. When setting up the Link between Contents, this original file will work as the**'Parent Content'** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778375604121) * Make design edits in CLO3D (ex. create a new Colorway or change fabric/material used) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391024153) * Once the design edit is complete, upload it as a new Content with 'Upload to CLO-SET' option. You can also select Render/Tech Pack via CLO-SET. * Please note that 'Linked Contents' feature is not compatible when uploading a new Version. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391314329) * Turn on the 'Linked Content' option to create the Parent-Child relationship. 1. Select the Group to upload the new Content. Please note that Contents in different Groups can not be 'Linked' as a Parent-Child. 2. Turn on 'Linked Content' button. 3. Select the Workroom to upload the new Content. Selecting an existing Content is disabled when the 'Linked Content' option is on. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391631769) * Once uploaded, you can click on 'Linked Contents' to view the Parent/Child Contents. in Content Page | From **'Child Content'** | From **'Parent Content'** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778391794841) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778376539673) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778376740505) ### 2) Requirements 1\. Rules for identifying 'Original Content' * The 'Original Content' is always the **first file** you open in CLO3D. * If you used multiple files from CLO-SET Library to create the new Content, only the very first file added would be linked as the Original Content. * If you started with a non-CLO-SET file and added files from CLO-SET library, the latter would **not** be linked as the Original Content. 2\. Rules for Parent-Child relationship * Both of the Parent & Child Contents **MUST** be in the same CLO-SET Group to utilize the 'Linked Content' feature.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to establish Parent-Child relationships between contents when uploading new files from CLO, enhancing asset tracking and management within the CLO-SET Library.

title: Attachment
content: #### **Objective** Upload Attachments as a reference for your Content 1. Attach file from local PC 2. Attach file from OneDrive # **Details** ### 1) Attach file from local PC ![Screenshot 2023-11-09 at 5.53.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778729251737) * From the Content page, click on the Attachment icon on the right pane. * To upload a file from your local PC, click on 'Upload a file' on the top. * Please note that the attachment file size must be less than 500mb. ### 2) Attach file from OneDrive ![Screenshot 2023-11-09 at 5.53.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778729251737) * You may also attach a file from your shared OneDrive folder * Click on 'OneDrive' button from the Attachment tab, and select the file you want to add.
content_description: Easily upload attachments from your local PC or OneDrive to enhance your content with relevant files.

title: Content Version Upload
content: # **Objective** You can upload a single file or turntable image as an uploaded version of a Content in Content page. # **Details** 1. Version Upload 2. Thumbnail Change 3. Version Rename 4. Version Deletion ### 1) Version Upload 1\. On the content page, click ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778870662041) to upload newer versions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778876309785) >2\. Select the file format you wish to upload. Also, you may choose NOT to notify other collaborators on the new version upload. ('Do not notify collaborator'). ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778876510105) #### ### 2) Thumbnail Change Select the file, and click 'Upload'. Once you upload the new version, CLO-SET will **automatically** update the content's thumbnail. If you wish to **keep the original thumbnail from earlier versions** , please turn on the 'Keep the current thumbnail' button. ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778898861465) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778907835417) ---|--- *The blue tab on your Version file indicates that there is Annotation on this content. *The 'Public' sign indicates that this content has been published to 'Embed Viewer' ### 3) Version Rename * From the Content page, hover over the Version you'd like to rename. * Click on •••, and then click 'Rename'. Type in the new Version name, and click 'Confirm'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778871785369) | ► | ![Screenshot 2023-10-10 at 4.33.42 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778899408409) ---|---|--- *Please note that updating the Version name will **NOT **update the Content Name. Double-click on the Content Name to edit. ### 3.1) Where are Version Names used? Changing the Version name will auto-update the fields below. ![Screenshot 2023-10-10 at 4.47.09 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778899536153) | ![Screenshot 2023-10-10 at 4.48.24 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778877737241) ---|--- * Downloaded file name * Comment, Annotation, Attachment, Colorway tab * WTP - Comment, Version update * File name in CLO (if updated the latest Version) ### 4)Version Deletion ![Screenshot 2023-10-10 at 5.34.51 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778893998617) 1\. You may delete a single version of the content, keeping all other versions live. To delete a specific version, click the ••• button next to it, and click 'Delete'. 2\. Once you delete a specific version, it will not be shown under the Versions list. To view all versions including the deleted ones, click on 'View all histories' on the top right corner. 3\. Please note that the deleted versions CANNOT be restored. Please be cautious when deleting a version with annotations, comments, or attachments.
content_description: This web page provides users with the tools to manage content versions by allowing uploads, thumbnail changes, renaming, and deletions of files.
